    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing systematic undershoot that increases with longer horizons",
    "Sentiment turning positive (1.00) correlates with model undershoot of 2-3 EUR compared to baseline forecasts",
    "When sentiment is negative (-0.33 to 0.00), model forecasts overestimate prices by 1-2 EUR",
    "Price mean reversion gap between model and outcomes grows from ~0.5 EUR at day 1-10 to ~2-3 EUR at day 25-30",
    "Sentiment momentum (rising from 0.00 to 1.00 over 3-4 steps) amplifies the forecast-error coefficient from 0.98 to 1.15",
    "Model lacks recognition of sentiment-inflected volatility clusters, producing flat forecasts in volatile periods",
    "When price history shows upward momentum, model under-responds by approximately 10% relative to sentiment signal strength"
] }
